docSummary.description: Summarizes long documents and highlights their key points.

Read the following document and write a summary of no more than 200 words. Include:
- Main topic
- Three key arguments
- Conclusions and recommendations

Document: {{document_content}}

emailReply.description: Drafts a concise, professional reply based on an incoming email.
emailReply.content:
Write a concise, professional reply to the following email. Requirements:
- Use a professional and courteous tone.
- Address every question raised.
- Keep the reply under 200 words.

Email: {{email_content}}
